text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃあ～！
　ま、また出てきましたよ～！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
This thing's way too stubborn for its own good!
Get yourself and those freaky tentacles out of here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しつこいわね～！
もうあんたの触手はこりごりなのよ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Something feels... different about it now.
It may be an even more vicious specimen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
なにやら、
先ほどまでとは雰囲気が違うようですね。
より凶暴な個体なのかもしれません。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it'll be even more delicious than the last one!
I knew the bounty would be rich if we kept at it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
さっきよりも味が凝縮されているってことですね！
見つけましたよ、
新たな海の幸！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: You really do live in your own little world, don't you...?
